selected_task.bounded_outcome: Explicit scale semantics, seven concrete acceptance cases, bounded static gap and one proposed shared task.

selection_reason: PF2 is active reference rank2 in all three scenarios. Its exact source is readable and existing acceptance was generic. Physical scale is an L1 prerequisite. Knave source preflight did not resolve readable final rule content; no rules were invented.

v1.4 already awaits owner approval; no new comparable audience denominator acquired. Concrete L1 acceptance has immediate development value.

findings.fact: Regular hex side-to-side diameter is √3/2 times corner-to-corner diameter.
findings.interpretation: 12 miles corner-to-corner =10.392304845413264 side-to-side. Interpreting 12 as side diameter instead would give 15.470% conditional difference; no actual numeric app bug claimed.

findings.fact: Canonical map.physical_hex_scale and PF2-RM-002-L1 binding already exist.
findings.interpretation: Refine one shared requirement/binding and propose one task; no duplicate canonical implementation.
